name: 561. An image priced only by its joint size and quality rate is billed at it: dall-e-3 hd and standard, 1024 and 1792, not $0 (image variant pricing)

item.name: 561.1 openai/fixture-dalle-3 POST /v1/images/generations quality hd 1024x1024 is billed $0.088, the hd rate, and the response says hd (image variant pricing)

exec: pm.test('the client gets 200 with one image', function () {
pm.test('the response carries the quality and size the image was priced by', function () {
// The fixture prices fixture-dalle-3 with dall-e-3's live upstream row: joint size and quality rates and no
// flat rate. 1024x1024 hd is $0.088. Before TXE-7356 the fork dropped hd at sync and billed $0.
pm.sendRequest({ url: BASE + '/api/logs?limit=50', method: 'GET', header: { 'X-Bifrost-Setup-Token': token } }, function (err, res) {
var row = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.id === requestId; })[0];

pm.test('the log row of this request is readable', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code, res.text()).to.equal(200); pm.expect(row, 'no log row for ' + requestId).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('the logged cost is the hd 1024x1024 rate, $0.088', function () { pm.expect(row && (row.cost || 0), JSON.stringify(row && { cost: row.cost })).to.be.closeTo(0.088, 1e-9); });
